description.value: Hampton Inn Vancouver Airport is a mid-scale Hilton-brand hotel situated in Richmond close to Vancouver International Airport, making it a practical stop for cyclists arriving or departing by air. As part of the Hampton by Hilton chain it offers standardized amenities expected of a full-service airport hotel. Its Bridgeport Road location places it near the Canada Line rapid transit corridor and within the broader Richmond cycling network.
